EES1.label: Account Management

EES1.1.label: Account Creation Requests
EES1.1.description: Requests for creating new user accounts or registration IDs, including new user account setup and registration ID requests.

EES1.2.label: Account Modification Requests
EES1.2.description: Requests to change account details such as email address updates or author email changes.

EES1.3.label: Account Deletion and Transfer Requests
EES1.3.description: Requests for account deletion or transfer, including user deactivation and account transfer requests.

EES1.4.label: Access Issues
EES1.4.description: Problems related to accessing accounts, including login issues and access due to unverified emails.

EES1.5.label: Other Account Management Issues
EES1.5.description: Cases that fall within account management but do not fit any specific leaf above.

EES1.description: This category covers issues related to user accounts, including creation, modification, and deletion requests.

EES2.label: Email Verification and Access

EES2.1.label: Email Verification Issues
EES2.1.description: Problems related to email verification, including not receiving verification emails and access issues due to unverified emails.

EES2.2.label: Institutional Email Access
EES2.2.description: Requests and issues regarding access to services using institutional emails, including registration and access requirements.

EES2.3.label: Access Code Registration Issues
EES2.3.description: Concerns related to the registration of access codes, including missing registration emails and alerts management.

EES2.4.label: Other Email Verification and Access Issues
EES2.4.description: Cases that fall within email verification and access but do not fit any specific leaf above.

EES2.description: This category encompasses issues related to email verification, access codes, and institutional email concerns.

EES3.label: User Access Management

EES3.1.label: User Access Requests
EES3.1.description: Requests for new user access or registration, including remote access registration and user access inquiries.

EES3.2.label: User Access Revocation
EES3.2.description: Issues related to the revocation of user access, including inquiries about access management.

EES3.3.label: Other User Access Management Issues
EES3.3.description: Cases that fall within user access management but do not fit any specific leaf above.

EES3.description: This category includes issues related to user access rights, revocations, and inquiries about user access.

EES4.label: General Inquiries

EES4.1.label: General Account Inquiries
EES4.1.description: Inquiries related to account management that do not specify a particular issue.

EES4.2.label: Other General Inquiries
EES4.2.description: Cases that fall within general inquiries but do not fit any specific leaf above.

EES4.description: This category covers general inquiries that do not fit into specific operational issues.
